settings.title: Niri Screensaver
settings.description: TerminalTextEffects screensaver wired into Noctalia's IdleService. Settings here write to ~/.config/niri-screensaver/config and update the idle hook automatically.

cliMissing.title: niri-screensaver CLI not found on PATH
cliMissing.desc: Install the bash side from https://github.com/jfreed-dev/niri-screensaver (run ./install.sh) and reload the plugin. Without it, the launch / kill commands below have nothing to drive.
